name: MosChip Technologies Limited
summary: MosChip Technologies Limited, a semiconductor and system design company, designs, develops, manufactures, and sells system on chip technologies and Internet on Things solutions in India, North America, and the Asia Pacific. It offers silicon engineering services, including turnkey ASIC and silicon design services, as well as IP porting, customization, and integration services. The company also provides product engineering services, such as hardware design and physical system engineering, embedded system and device engineering, digital engineering for cloud-native experiences, AI engineering, and quality and automation engineering services.
